Gulabi Visionaries
Empowering Women Entrepreneurs Network

About Gulabi Visionaries
Empowering women to thrive in business
We provide: 
- Referrals, 
- Business 
- Marketing
- Social media Management
- Virtual business card and
- Networking opportunities to elevate women in their
entrepreneurial journeys.

Mission statement
Gulabi Visionaries
Our mission at Gulabi Visionaries is to unite
Visionary women, nurture their entrepreneurial
spirit, and create opportunities for collaboration,
learning and growth. 
Through Networking meets, Whatsapp Marketing,
Insta marketing we build a supportive ecosystem
where women uplift one another, celebrate each
other’s successes, and rise together to create
lasting economic and social impact.

Goals of Gulabi
Visionaries
Community growth - 
We are a thriving community of 300+
passionate women entrepreneurs in Gulabi
Visionaries.
We are a supporting and strong referral system. 
Visibility and Branding
Strong Whatsapp community, Instagram and
Youtube presence.
Featured in Rajasthan Media.
Recognized as a premium women Enterpreneur
platform.

Goals of Gulabi
Visionaries
Digital Expansion
Gulabi Visionaries Podcast a
professional talkshow for Women
Enterpreneurs.
You tube channel with Business stories
Business Impact 
Members achieve measurable revenue
growth
Cross collaborations between members

Visionaries
Events & Recognition
Plan an Annual Gulabi Summit
Award functions

Spotify
Roadmap for next Year
Target by Dec 2026

Rules of the meeting
1. Attend 3 meetings out of the 6 meetings planned
in the year.
2.Come on time and silent your phone. We value
your time and business please value the
community too.
3.Feature presenter has to bring a wrapped door
prize it can be anything that you like below 500/- 
4. Please take care of the referrals that you get at
the end of the meeting and try to give them a
lead or take a small business of minimum 100Rs
or so.

Discipline
1. We need to share our business Flyer to the
admins when asked to do so.
2.We need to put others business Flyer on our
Whatsapp status. If found not doing so then we
shall have to remove the member for a week. 
3. Please learn about Insta status marketing and
even do the same for the members as shared.
4.Learn all the technical issues from the founders
personally. They shall help but only if you ask.

Key Benefits
of Joining
Connect with like-minded women entrepreneurs
and expand your professional network through
events and collaboration.
Networking Opportunities
Gain valuable referral, guides to help you grow
your business efficiently.
Access to Referrals
Business and Support
Members shall be engaged to give business and
support your entrepreneurial journey. We have
the feature of business sharing on WhatsApp
status or Insta story sharing.
